body: <sf-file-download id="d" file-name="Отчёт.pdf" file-size="2,4 МБ" href="/fixture/report" download></sf-file-download>
<sf-file-download id="d-off" file-name="Архив.zip" file-size="120 МБ" href="/fixture/zip" disabled></sf-file-download>
<sf-file-download id="d-tab" file-name="Договор.pdf" file-type="PDF" file-size="84 КБ" href="/fixture/report" target="_blank"></sf-file-download>

checks.title: href draws a native download link named by the file

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#d a.sf-download-file'); return a && a.getAttribute('href') === '/fixture/report' && a.getAttribute('download') === 'Отчёт.pdf' && a.textContent.includes('Отчёт.pdf') && a.textContent.includes('2,4 МБ'); })()

checks.title: a press sends sf-file-download-request, then its dated former names sf-file-download-download, sf-download-file-download and sf-download-file:click, one detail
a refused request stops the link

steps.script: (() => { window.__prevented = null; document.addEventListener('sf-file-download-request', (e) => e.preventDefault(), {once: true}); document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { window.__prevented = e.defaultPrevented; }, {once: true}); document.querySelector('#d a').click(); return true; })()

checks.title: disabled draws a disabled button and sends nothing

steps.script: (() => { window.__dl = 0; document.addEventListener('sf-file-download-request', () => { window.__dl += 1; }); document.querySelector('#d-off button').click(); return true; })()

checks.title: a size off the ladder reads as 1
the former name --sf-download-file-radius is still read under --sf-file-download-radius until 2027-01-01 (DF-11)
a file link with neither download nor target downloads in the same tab, named by its last part; the type stands before the size (decision C25)
checks.covers: settings.target default, settings.download, settings.file-name default, settings.file-type

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#d-plain a.sf-download-file'); return a && !a.hasAttribute('target') && a.getAttribute('download') === 'Состав.csv' && a.querySelector('.sf-download-file__name').textContent === 'Состав.csv' && document.querySelector('#d-tab .sf-download-file__type').textContent === 'PDF' && document.querySelector('#d-tab .sf-download-file__size').textContent === '84 КБ'; })()

checks.title: target="_blank" opens a tab to view, with the open_in_new sign and words for a screen reader, and no download

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#d-tab a.sf-download-file'); return a && a.getAttribute('target') === '_blank' && !a.hasAttribute('download') && a.querySelector('.sf-download-file__tab').textContent === 'open_in_new' && a.textContent.includes('(откроется в новой вкладке)') && a.querySelector('.sf-download-file__icon').textContent === 'download'; })()

checks.title: the host takes the press and prepares the file: spinner in the sign's place, «Готовим файл…», aria-busy, a second press sends nothing; error shows the row itself -- a group named by the file, «Не удалось собрать», «Повторить» at its end -- whose press sends sf-file-download-retry (decisions C25, C51)

steps.script: (() => { window.__n = 0; const f = document.querySelector('#d-prep'); f.addEventListener('sf-file-download-request', (e) => { window.__n += 1; e.preventDefault(); f.setAttribute('state', 'preparing'); }); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#d-prep button'); return window.__n === 1 && b.getAttribute('aria-busy') === 'true' && b.querySelector('.sf-download-file__spinner') && !b.querySelector('.sf-download-file__icon') && b.textContent.includes('Готовим файл…'); })()

(() => { const row = document.querySelector('#d-prep .sf-download-file--error'); const retry = row && row.querySelector('sf-button.sf-download-file__retry'); return row && row.getAttribute('role') === 'group' && row.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Отчёт.xlsx' && row.textContent.includes('Не удалось собрать') && retry && retry.getAttribute('text') === 'Повторить' && retry.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Повторить: Отчёт.xlsx' && !document.querySelector('#d-prep sf-alert') && document.querySelector('#d-prep [role="alert"]').textContent.includes('не удалось собрать «Отчёт.xlsx»'); })()

checks.title: in a flex row of the page the failed row and its reason stand in the component's own column, the reason under the row (DF-13, decision C51)

steps.check: (() => { const stack = document.querySelector('#d-err .sf-download-file__stack'); const row = stack && stack.querySelector(':scope > .sf-download-file--error').getBoundingClientRect(); const reason = stack && stack.querySelector(':scope > .sf-download-file__reason').getBoundingClientRect(); return Boolean(stack) && reason.top >= row.bottom && Math.abs(reason.left - row.left) < 1; })()

checks.title: value draws the progress ring and «Готовим… 45 %»; cancelable puts «Отменить» beside the row, whose press sends sf-file-download-cancel and, not prevented, returns the row to ready; the start and the cancel are said (decision C51)

steps.script: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#d-run'); f.addEventListener('sf-file-download-request', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); f.setAttribute('value', '45'); f.setAttribute('state', 'preparing'); }); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#d-run'); const b = f.querySelector('button.sf-download-file'); return b.getAttribute('aria-busy') === 'true' && b.querySelector('.sf-download-file__ring .sf-progress-ring') && b.textContent.includes('45') && f.querySelector('sf-button.sf-download-file__cancel') && f.querySelector('[role="status"]').textContent === 'Готовим файл «Выгрузка заказов.csv»'; })()

(() => { const f = document.querySelector('#d-run'); return f.getAttribute('state') === 'ready' && !f.querySelector('.sf-download-file__cancel') && f.querySelector('[role="status"]').textContent === 'Подготовка отменена: «Выгрузка заказов.csv»'; })()

checks.title: a file that comes later than 10 s after the press is not fetched by itself: the row says «Готово» with the type and the size and offers «Скачать <name>» (decision C51)

steps.script: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#d-long'); f.addEventListener('sf-file-download-request', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); f.setAttribute('state', 'preparing'); }); return true; })()

(() => { const f = document.querySelector('#d-long'); f._pressedAt -= 11000; f.setAttribute('file-size', '3 КБ'); f.setAttribute('href', '/fixture/report'); f.setAttribute('state', 'ready'); return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#d-long'); const row = f.querySelector('.sf-download-file--offer'); const get = f.querySelector('sf-button.sf-download-file__get'); return row && row.textContent.includes('Готово') && row.textContent.includes('3 КБ') && get && get.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Скачать Заказы за год.csv' && f.querySelector('[role="status"]').textContent.includes('Кнопка «Скачать»'); })()

checks.title: the row is as wide as its text and full-width fills the container; the type and the size stand right after the name and are said with the unit in words, the seen «CSV · 112 Б» hidden (decision C51)

steps.check: (() => { const col = document.querySelector('#col').getBoundingClientRect(); const fit = document.querySelector('#d-fit .sf-download-file'); const full = document.querySelector('#d-full .sf-download-file').getBoundingClientRect(); const name = fit.querySelector('.sf-download-file__name').getBoundingClientRect(); const meta = fit.querySelector('.sf-download-file__meta'); return fit.getBoundingClientRect().width < col.width / 2 && Math.abs(full.width - col.width) < 1 && meta.getBoundingClientRect().left - name.right < 16 && meta.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' && fit.querySelector('.sf-download-file__said').textContent === ', CSV, 112 байт'; })()
